quote: Other future directions include extending this work to infinite or continuous state spaces, and designing algorithms that achieve sub-linear dynamic regret even for large V_n (rapidly varying kernels).
claimed_gap: No known algorithm achieves sub-linear dynamic regret for restless-bandit Whittle-index learning when the transition kernel varies rapidly (variation budget V_n not o(T)).

estimated_compute: pure numpy/python, small finite MDPs, well under 1s per episode, full sweep in low minutes on CPU

quote: A natural direction for future work is to move beyond open-loop policies toward adaptive strategies.

proposed_verifier: Reimplement the paper's open-loop ETC baseline for a simplified latent-AR-dynamics linear bandit environment. estimated_compute: pure numpy, low-dimensional linear bandit simulation, seconds per run, CPU only
